Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) physics & packaging bound on minimum feasible size for the Porcelain Scarab while retaining 100% of current indoor functionality (including 40mm 2.7g ping-pong ball fetch, 1.2g card suction courier, 0W mirror perch, 4-stage cam, and Optical Flow/ToF): (1) Tier 1 Off-the-Shelf COTS (StampFly + XIAO): 81 x 81 x 24 mm (180 mm span, 41.65 g, 33 mm ducts); (2) Tier 2 Custom Single-PCB HDI Floor (Macaron / AirPods Pro Case Size): 58 x 58 x 19 mm closed -> 125 mm wingspan, 25.0 g dry / 27.7 g ball-loaded, using four 24 mm ducts + 0702 brushless motors on a 31 mm wheelbase + 200 mAh high-rate cell. Carrying the 2.7 g (40 mm) ball at x = +30 mm ahead of CG (to clear the 42-deg Optical Flow cone) requires 8.23 g/motor on the front pair (71.6% of 11.5 g max thrust, leaving 28.4% control authority) and preserves ~3.6 min hover; (3) Hard Physics Wall Below 55 mm (e.g., 42 x 42 mm Coin Drone, 16 g): Front 18 mm ducts saturate at 102.4% thrust and flip nose-over under the 81 g*mm ball torque, or pulling the 40 mm ball rearward blocks >65% of the Optical Flow cone, while disk loading spikes to 1.83 g/cm2 (>72 dBA whine, <78s flight).

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) root-cause analysis on why the Porcelain Scarab has not been built yet: (1) The Three-Tribe Blindspot: Drone companies (DJI, HoverAir, Snap) optimize for continuous flight endurance and outdoor speed so non-lifting beetle shells and a 5-min battery look like failure; Academic biomimetic labs (EPFL, Konkuk KUBeetle, Harvard) insisted on generating lift from flapping wings (sacrificing payload, camera stability, and acoustics) and viewed a hidden quadrotor under decorative elytra as cheating; Desk-pet makers (EMO, Loona, LOVOT) stayed on wheels to avoid rotor noise, blade hazards, and autonomous docking failures. (2) Systems-Economics Convergence (2024-2026): Off-the-shelf integration of  shrouded optical-flow/ToF quads (StampFly), 3.5g edge-vision SoCs (XIAO ESP32S3), 1.5g linear servos, and 0.4mm consumer vase-mode printing dropped the cost of attempting the synthesis from k lab custom work to ~. (3) The Real Engineering Bottlenecks (Making the 100th Unattended Landing Boring): Passive suction fails on porous drywall (must use mirrors/glass or magnetic wall target discs), 31-35mm ducts are ~62-66 dBA (making 12s hops + 0W perch mandatory), and optical flow drifts in dim light (requiring forgiving mechanical funnel + fiducial terminal guidance).
